entries.note: Milestone M1: the docket is booked at the branch that takes the goods, which the tracking page calls the pickup.
Milestone M2: left the booking branch.
Received at the branch or transhipment centre the wording names; no milestone.
Sent on to the location the wording names; no milestone.
Milestone M4: at the delivery branch.
Milestone M6, with the reason, such as Consignee Premises Closed, Consignee Request For Rescheduling or Force Majeure External Reasons. The docket goes out for delivery again.
Milestone M7: some of the docket's packages were delivered and the rest came on a later delivery.
Milestone M8. The docket's own status reads Delivered too.
The docket is held; the wording names no reason. Seen months after a delivery, whose docket status stayed Delivered.
Status column of Gati's former tracker at gati.com in an archived lookup.
Listed in TrackingMore's table of Gati KWE statuses.
Listed in TrackingMore's table of Gati KWE statuses: at the destination branch.
Listed in TrackingMore's table of Gati KWE statuses: held after missing a connection.
The tracking service's answer for a docket it does not know; not an event.
